verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub org (fivetran/fivetran-mcp). It answers read-only questions about sync status and broken connections by default. Write and delete operations unlock through FIVETRAN_SCOPE, credential endpoints can be denylisted, and it supports workflows like copying connections to a new destination. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably, and documented client setup/installation steps (or a hosted endpoint) in the evidence.
